content:
lee: Heads-up: provisioning alert — EU cluster dropped 10 GPUs overnight, appears tied to RMA batch G-3491 (vendor reported mislabeled serials).
dana: Oof. Which availability zones impacted?
lee: eu-west-1a & 1c. Dedicated allocations show 15% less headroom; two customers on reserved pools could see throttling.
mike: Can we tap the temporary spares pool in AMS? What's the cross-region transit time if we use a courier air-escort?
nexasupply-rep: We have a small temporary pool in AMS (8 units) — can dispatch same-day with courier air-escort. Standard transit 24-48h + customs hold if docs incomplete. We can do pre-clearance (extra fee) to avoid customs delays.
procurement: Fee details? Pre-clearance adds ~USD 1,200 per shipment; courier surcharge depends on weight/route.
dana: If we accept courier+preclear, that's faster than pulling US spares and routing. But need to confirm firmware parity.
lee: Firmware/BIOS note: eu fleet uses firmware baseline fw-2024.07. Vendor said AMS spares are on fw-2024.05. We can patch in depot but need 2-3 hours per host and reboot schedule.
hannah: Risk: patching in-depot might change perf curves; need a micro-canary to validate perf and KV cache behavior. Suggest rolling 1 unit to canary as soon as depot accepts.
ops-bot: Logistics update: manifest MR-9902 created. Tracking ID assigned when AWB is booked.
mike: Cost vs SLA tradeoff: pre-clear + courier avoids 3-5 business day customs; cost ~USD 20k vs using US spares (realloc + egress) which costs ~USD 6k but 72-96h lead and causes KV cold-starts.
procurement: Also factor vendor credit for RMA replacements. NexaSupply has an expedite credit policy but needs supporting docs.
nexasupply-rep: Confirming: expedite credit up to 25% of courier surcharge on approved claims. For pre-clearance we require HS code 8471.80 and photos + manifest.
dana: Operational plan proposal: (1) Accept AMS temporary pool dispatch with pre-clearance, (2) schedule depot firmware patch and canary, (3) open procurement PO for full replacements (12 units) with vendor ETA calendar, (4) ask vendor to invoice shipping/fees separately for later credit.
lee: +1. Add contingency B: if depot rejects units on arrival, request immediate swap from vendor EU refurb pool.
mike: Who owns the maintenance window? We need to drain pods gracefully to avoid tail latencies. Ops can do 01:00-04:00 UTC window tomorrow.
hannah: I'll own the canary validation script and perf checks (90th/99th token latency, KV hit rate). If anything >15% delta, we rollback.
procurement: I'll prepare the PO and escrow line. Need vendor proforma invoice before we book courier. NexaSupply, can you push proforma today?
nexasupply-rep: Will upload proforma + tentative AWB by EOD. We'll also include depot contact for firmware patching coordination.
ops-bot: Status note: manifest MR-9902 awaiting AWB. ETA estimates: 2024-08-23 03:00 UTC if courier booked today.
lee: OK locking plan. Action items: procurement create PO, nexasupply upload proforma, ops reserve 01:00-04:00 UTC window, hannah prepare canary checks, mike coordinate drain script. I'll file INF-4602 to track.
procurement: Done — PO draft created, linking to INF-4602.
dana: Thanks team. We'll reconvene on thread after AWB + proforma. :thumbsup:
